svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One piece of 5 mm 6082-T6 aluminium plate, profile cut.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Outline from the front edge (the edge toward the trunk):

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 175 long at the bottom, 185 high at the front; 55 high at

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the back end; the top runs 60 back, then slopes down.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Holes: load eye 22 at 150 back, 28 up; spare eye 22 at 85

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: back, 28 up; lightening hole 36 at 85 back, 90 up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Chain slots: two, 7.5 wide, 35 deep from the top edge, centred 15 and 43 back from the front edge. Cut them

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: square and file every edge smooth; no burr may touch chain.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lock pin hole 8.5 at 29 back, 139 up (drill after the cheeks

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: are welded on, through all three plates).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Do not thicken the plate: a link must span it (6 mm at most).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Round the eye edges to 2 mm radius after the rings go on.
